notes.title: Playtest update
Update and availability
notes.content:
[h1]MacOS and Linux[/h1]
We've added Linux and MacOS versions of Lostria to Steam! If you have one of these OS, you can now enjoy our game with the playtest version!

[h1]Steam functions[/h1]
We have also started to add Steam features like the leaderboard and microtransactions (sandbox version for the moment) don't hesitate to come and test it all :)

Coming Soon: Using Steam Stats, Achievements and More!

notes.title: It's the beginning!
notes.content:
Hellow everyone!

We have finally released the test version on Steam, feel free to test and share your opinions :)

[h1]Planning[/h1]
Although the game is functional, it is still in development and a lot of work remains to be done. For the moment, we have limited ourselves to the Windows version for better control, the Mac and Linux versions are planned for soon.

Now that the game is on Steam, our priority is to get the Steam features up and running (Achievements, Invite a Friend, Leaderboard, Microtransaction, etc.) and make sure everything runs smoothly.

On the artistic side, we'll do our best to complete the base character set before the end of the year.

[h1]Stream and Kickstarter[/h1]
In order to ensure that we have the necessary funds for the proper development of the project, we will launch a crowdfunding campaign on Kickstarter. This campaign will begin on July 23, 2021 for a period of 30 days.

For the event, we are organizing a Streaming session where we will play Lostria with the community while answering your questions. From the perspective of an international community, we will try to stream in English.

Head over to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/krystagames]twitch.tv/krystagames[/ url] on July 23 at 4pm (utc + 2) to play with us!


Thank you again to everyone who supported the project so far and also thank you to everyone who will support it in the future <3
